name: handily-reply-view
description: Long replies fold to their first lines, tables draw with rules between their columns or in a full box with Table style box, each table and code block gets a copy button, and each prompt you type opens under a coloured rule labelled you.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether replies and typed prompts draw in the reply view (on) or as Claude Code draws them (off) when a session starts. /replies toggles one session.

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.description: Whether a mermaid flowchart in a reply draws as a diagram (on) or as its source, as a code block (off).

diagramHints.title: Diagram hints
diagramHints.description: Whether each prompt that you type carries one hint about mermaid diagrams, of about 140 tokens (on), or no hint (off). /replies hints toggles one session.

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: How a table in a reply draws: rules between the columns (rules) or a full box (box). Under 40 columns no box draws, and a table that does not fit draws one block for each row.
